source: TEAM_GALACTIC_SINNOH_FULL_3 part D, TEAM_PLASMA_UNOVA_FULL_3 part D, HOENN_TEAMS 7.5 (the Radio). Lines are the docs' own; the Radio's chatter lines are fill-ins.

low: I've run the numbers on you. Inconclusive.
mid: You're restful. I mean that as high as I can mean anything.
That shouldn't have worked. I'd like to see your working.
high: I've four minutes. For you I've got eight.
If I'm right about the last page, I'd like it noted that I'd rather have been wrong, with you lot.

mid: Things take longer when it's us.
Eleven minutes. Then a metre. I can see a trend.
high: Saturn's stopped timing you. Is that good?
He knows. He's logging it as weather.

low: You're only a Listener. You'll see.
mid: You've a way of looking at the fence.
You'd have made an orderly. You notice the ears.
high: If I've got this wrong, I want you to be the one who says.
I've handed back a lot of patients. I'd hand one to you.

mid: The Sages ask about you. I say you're devout.
Giallo's had your reports pulled. Rood's got them. Don't ask me which is worse.
high: I've a dog in my shirt. I can't be the one who vouches.
They'll ask you to open your hand. Do it. Trust the dog.

lines.text: *She hums. A table away, somebody taps one finger*
"It's different." *Nobody answers. Several nod*
"I thought it was the warm."
"Four hundred and seventy-six." *To nobody*
"...How are you, Io?" Io: "*Late!* I dreamed I was late!"
"You're going up with him. What's it like? Being required?"
"They say Commander Saturn carried one. In his *hands.*"
"Did you write one? I can't remember what I put. Isn't that odd. It was the whole reason."
"Tomorrow there's no more of this." *A pause.* "I've been trying to work out which 'this' he means."
*They don't fight. They step aside, and take the helmet off, and hold it*
"Yes. Exactly that."
"...Is that the cadet's? It's got into the building. I've not been able to locate the source."
"Seen."
"You mind. I'm observing that you mind. Continue."
"Four minutes. Take them."

lines.who: A new Knight, to the ceiling
lines.text: "I didn't look back. I did it right. I didn't look."
*Something under her tunic sneezes.* "Hay fever."
"They say a Listener asked the *crowd's.* In the square. Is that allowed?" Another: "It's the *Speech.* It's just the Speech, done."
"We've met. The six of us. First time in two years. Nobody knew what to say. Bronius took minutes."
"He'll walk the fields. He'll tell us what they said."
"All right, candles?"
"I've stopped having the egg."
"Don't *tell* me where it's from. I've got to lift it."
"...Are we still getting paid Friday? Who do I ask?"
"Yours said 'again.' I think it likes this part."
"It's all right. It says it's all right. It says tell you."
"It says that one tastes of chalk. It took it anyway."
"I talk too fast. He made me, so there'd be no gaps. You can have a gap. Look: there's one."
"It suits you."
"A Sage who stands. How original. I did that for two years; it's hard on the knees."
*You ask him something. He answers beautifully.*
"Look moved. It needn't be real. Mine never is, and they weep."

magma: "Unit four, readings nominal. Unit four, stop eating on the gauge."
"Reminder: forms in triplicate. The third copy is for Courtney."
"Mt. Chimney cable car is ours till six. Look busy."
aqua: "All hands, the galley's out of eggs. Again."
"Somebody's left the dinghy at Slateport. It's the blue one. They're all blue."
"Tide's turning at Lilycove. So's Shelly. Steer clear."
